series.title: Soil Conservation Technician
series.statusStatement: Active (EMST OPM series register, as of 2026-10-23).
series.qualificationStandardVersion: Technical & Medical Support Positions group std (education may substitute)
series.educationNote: from EMST's series record; not yet checked against the OPM qualification standard, so confirm with the HR office

generalCompetencies: not mapped in this release (X9 USA Hire and FWCI parts not built; WP-09 open item 6)

roles.functionStatement: Collect and record defensible field observations and samples to protocol, and verify automated and remote products against what is on the ground.

bands.indicativeBand: GS-3 to GS-5 (entry); GS-6 to GS-7 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Sample and assess vegetation using standardized field protocols

tasks.statement: Establish vegetation monitoring plots to protocol and record species composition, cover and density within the program's measurement-quality objectives
Identify plants on sample plots to the protocol's required taxonomic level, collecting labelled vouchers for any plant not identified with certainty
Adapt the vegetation sampling layout when burned, flooded or grazed site conditions depart from protocol assumptions, recording the deviation for comparability

majorDuties.duty: Detect and record wildlife by direct observation, sign and standardized surveys

tasks.statement: Conduct point-count, transect or call-playback wildlife surveys to protocol, recording detections, distance bands and survey conditions
Identify wildlife sign such as tracks, scat, nests and feeding remains to species or group, recording a confidence level for each record
Deploy camera traps and acoustic recorders at survey stations to the protocol's height, orientation and settings, recording station metadata

majorDuties.duty: Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field

tasks.statement: Measure temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity and turbidity in place with field meters calibrated before use and checked afterward
Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection
Collect benthic macroinvertebrate, algae or fish community samples from a stream reach following the program's habitat-allocation protocol

majorDuties.duty: Describe, test and sample soils in the field

tasks.statement: Describe a soil profile's horizons, colour, texture, structure and coarse fragments in standard terminology on the program's description form
Collect soil samples at specified depths and locations for laboratory analysis of texture, nutrients, carbon or contaminants

majorDuties.duty: Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings

tasks.statement: Identify regional plants and animals to species with dichotomous keys and diagnostic features, collecting evidence for any record not identified with certainty
Accept, correct or reject AI-suggested species identifications against the specimen, image or recording, recording the diagnostic reason for each change

majorDuties.duty: Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity

tasks.statement: Record field observations on a mobile form or paper data sheet at the time of observation, completing every protocol field and metadata element
Check location accuracy, photo documentation and required fields for each record before leaving the site, correcting errors while conditions can still be observed
Transfer the day's field records to the program database, reconciling record counts against field logs and reporting any loss

majorDuties.duty: Manage field sample custody and field quality control

tasks.statement: Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check
Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them

majorDuties.duty: Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination

tasks.statement: Collect trace-metal, emerging-contaminant or genetic samples using clean-hands procedures and the contaminant-free materials the method specifies

majorDuties.duty: Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids

tasks.statement: Plan a field route and travel times from maps and terrain, identifying water crossings, cliffs, weather exposure and bail-out points
Navigate off trail to a remote plot or site by map and compass, using satellite positioning as a check rather than the only means

majorDuties.duty: Apply field biosecurity and decontamination protocols

tasks.statement: Decontaminate boots, gear, boats and vehicles between field sites with the protocol's method and contact time for the target organisms

majorDuties.duty: Operate small boats and work safely on water in aquatic, coastal and marine field settings

tasks.statement: Wade streams and shorelines for sampling within safe depth-velocity limits, using a wading staff and a planned exit route

majorDuties.duty: Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems

tasks.statement: Capture imagery or thermal data that meet a mission's accuracy requirement by placing and surveying ground control and check points

majorDuties.duty: Deploy, maintain and verify field sensor networks

tasks.statement: Service deployed field sensors on schedule, cleaning, recalibrating or replacing components and recording each action in the service log

majorDuties.duty: Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field

tasks.statement: Record reference observations at pre-selected validation points with the reference protocol, without access to the product's predicted value
Code the likely field cause of each mismatch between a remote product and field observation, such as timing, mixed pixels, hidden understory or location error

majorDuties.duty: Validate AI-generated work products before professional use

tasks.statement: Verify an AI-generated field product, such as a condition map or drafted inspection note, against observations made at the site before it is relied on

majorDuties.duty: Lead field crews and transfer field judgment to novices

tasks.statement: Explain to a newer crew member the field cues behind a call, such as a look-alike plant or a gully head, so the novice can apply them
Lead a small crew through a field day, matching tasks to skill and checking novice work early and often

majorDuties.duty: Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments

tasks.statement: Conduct a job hazard analysis at the actual work site before field activity begins, naming each hazard present and its control
Stop field work when hazards change beyond the controls in the job hazard analysis, re-briefing the crew before work resumes

majorDuties.duty: Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings

tasks.statement: Assess an injured or ill person in a remote location with a structured patient assessment, giving first aid within the scope of training

majorDuties.duty: Drive and operate field vehicles safely on unpaved roads and off road

tasks.statement: Drive a four-wheel-drive vehicle on unpaved and off-road routes, selecting gear, speed and line for mud, sand, snow, rock and water crossings

majorDuties.duty: Read site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence

tasks.statement: Interpret fire scars, stumps, soil horizons and legacy structures at a site to reconstruct its disturbance and land-use history

knowledgeStatements: Stop-work authority lets any worker halt a task they judge unsafe; the task resumes only after the hazard is assessed and the plan revised, and the person who stopped it is not penalized.
A no-blame incident review separates system and condition causes from individual error and sanctions only reckless or wilful acts, so that people keep reporting near misses.
